description:
224 steady cases, vertical Nimonic-80 tube, 12.62 mm bore, heated lengths 3.66 m and 5.56 m, uniform heat flux, 27 axial thermocouples. G = 393-5235 kg/m2/s, inlet subcooling 42-181 kJ/kg. UKAEA Harwell High Pressure Two-Phase Heat Transfer Loop.

Caveat: measures wall temperature but NOT non-equilibrium vapour temperature or actual quality, so it constrains an equilibrium formulation only.

Relevant to the 1D dryout / post-dryout work (op-dt3.15, op-dt3.16) — this is the reference data those would be judged against.

Scope context: crates/tampines-steam-tables/docs/validation-scope-turbine-and-pipe.md section 4.3.
title: V&V: post-dryout wall temperature — Bennett et al. (1967), AERE-R5373

description: Phase 0 of the MELCOR-lite epic (op-exw). THIS IS A MAINTAINER DECISION, not approved work: a new workspace member is not currently sanctioned anywhere in CLAUDE.md. Decide whether to create a new lumped-parameter crate (deliberately NOT mesh-based) consuming tampines-steam-tables + outram-park-fork-coolprop for EOS and teh-o-prke for kinetics. If yes, settle once and deliberately the boundary pattern: strongly-typed uom struct in -> dimensionless scaled residual vector inside the Newton solve -> typed struct out. Nothing else in the epic can start until this is settled.
title: melcor: DECISION — crate shape + the uom-boundary solver pattern

description:
DeltaFlight.virtual_collisions exists (delta_tracking.rs:276) and the driver DISCARDS it - delta_flight returns Option<(Position, usize, Direction)> (keff_delta.rs:464) and drops the count.

There is currently NO measured rejection rate for any HTR-10 run in this crate. Worse, MAX_VIRTUAL = 100_000 per flight (keff_delta.rs:873) LEAKS the history silently on exhaustion (:901).

Without this the whole B4C-poisons-the-majorant argument stays theoretical rather than measured.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content:
PARTIAL -- the PURPOSE is met, the literal scope is not, so leaving open.

The point of this bead was to justify the Phase 1 rewrite with a number instead of an analogy. That is now done, by a route that needed no driver change at all: examples/majorant_absorber_price.rs (commit 9e1241327b) measures the majorant VALUE with and without a B4C rod in the bounded set. Since delta tracking samples s = -ln(xi)/Sigma_maj, tracking steps are directly proportional to the majorant, so the ratio IS the cost multiplier -- free of sampling noise, and no transport required.

MEASURED 2026-09-17: 26.3x at the thermal peak, 27.8x worst, 11.3x mean, and exactly 1.00x from ~1 keV upward. That matches the ~25x already measured for the undiluted kernel (dh_universe.rs:101-108). The energy structure was not predicted and is the useful part: the penalty is thermal/epithermal only, which is exactly where a graphite-moderated pebble bed lives.

STILL OPEN as originally written: delta_flight (keff_delta.rs:464) still discards DeltaFlight.virtual_collisions, so there is still no per-run measured rejection rate, and MAX_VIRTUAL = 100_000 still leaks histories silently on exhaustion (:873, :901). Those remain worth doing -- this measurement prices the pathology in the abstract, it does not tell you what any given HTR-10 run actually paid.

title: Phase 1.5: instrument the virtual-collision rejection rate

description:
gh:#196 — https://github.com/theodoreOnzGit/outram-park-backend/issues/196

RECORDED_PCM = 57.0 in examples/godiva_keff_endf_local.rs, and the +57 +/- 173 pcm it
encodes, is a -0.97 sigma single-seed draw of a distribution whose true mean (pre-#192)
was +228 +/- 18 pcm. Measured 2026-09-13 by a 96-seed paired study (5000 histories x
[40 inactive + 120 active], ENDF/B-VIII.0, all three ICSBEP nuclides, 57.6M active
histories per arm). Post-fix true mean is +314 +/- 21 pcm; today's single-seed +420 is a
+0.52 sigma draw of that.

Cited at 15 sites across 8 files plus the constant itself (grep, 2026-09-13).

Also: assert_reproduces_keff sizes its drift gate at 4 sigma of ONE run, but when the code
has changed the two arms are independent, so the relevant spread is sqrt(2)*sigma ~ 250 pcm
- the +/-649 pcm gate is really 2.6 sigma.

Fix: re-baseline to a pooled multi-seed mean + sem (record seed count and per-seed sd),
size the gate on sqrt(2)*sigma, then sweep the citation sites from the pooled number.

Not measured: Jemima (+6 +/- 173), godiva_keff_endf, endf_to_keff carry the same stale
single-seed baselines and have not been re-run.
title: outram-mc: Godiva's +57 ± 173 pcm baseline is a single-seed draw; drift gate sized at the wrong sigma

description: GH #37 §B. Cut new edges through faces along a supplied polyline; angle constraint, midpoint snap, cut-through occluded, only-selected. Knife Project: cut using another object's silhouette projected onto the target.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: src/knife.rs (new, ~300 LOC + 4 tests): knife(mesh, &[Chord]) -> KnifeResult. Chord{face, from: KnifePoint, to: KnifePoint} where KnifePoint = Vertex | EdgeSplit{edge,t}. Resolves edge-split points to new verts (dedup per (edge, rounded-t)), groups chords by face, splices edge-split verts into every ring that shares the edge (watertight), then split_ring divides each face by each chord sequentially. Verified: quad->2, vertex-to-edge cut, 2 parallel chords -> 3 pieces, diagonal cube-face cut stays closed (chi=2). Polyline/silhouette -> Chord resolver (Knife Project) noted as follow-up under this bead. clippy clean.

title: outram-blender: knife tool + knife project (polyline cut through faces)
